rationale: The plan selects limma-voom with a fixed-effects ~condition model and eBayes for an unpaired 60-vs-60 single-batch cohort, which is exactly the reference choice, and adds a Wilcoxon rank-sum concordance check appropriate to the population-scale n; it is specific to this design rather than generic. Filtering (filterByExpr with group, before normalization, kept-gene count reported), TMM inside voom with an explicit prohibition on pre-normalized input, an explicitly set reference level and a named case-vs-control contrast direction are all correct and stated. Effect-size handling is the strongest part: BH at 0.05, a p-value histogram check, TREAT at log2FC 1.0 and 0.5 inside the model rather than a post-hoc fold-change filter, logFC with SE and 95% CI beside every p-value, and an explicit justification for omitting apeglm shrinkage. Enrichment is exemplary — camera with data-estimated inter-gene correlation plus fgsea preranked on the moderated t, hallmark 2026.1 with a stated GO-BP substitution, tested-gene universe, 15-500 size window applied after intersection, seed, redundancy collapse, and unmapped share. QC is thorough (VST-blind PCA, distance heatmap, library sizes, zero fractions, outlier policy, unexplained-structure reporting) but omits the reference's sex check against XIST/Y-linked genes and does not name candidate hidden factors to test against PCs, which is the only real gap.
